name: Gomez&Wednesday
content:
Gomez and Wednesday. The bond is family first and does not stay only that. He has always loved her with a ferocity that other fathers would call too much; she has always measured him as the one man in the house whose noise she would not have silenced. What has changed is the current running under the old shape.

He finds her increasingly attractive and has stopped pretending the feeling is only pride. The composure she took from Morticia lands on him now as a face he wants to look at too long: moonlight skin against the severe black of her braids, the heavy-lidded dark eyes that strip a room, the blood-red mouth held in that flat unsmiling line he used to read as childhood gravity and now reads as a mouth. Her figure has finished the Addams argument her face began. The corseted hourglass — narrow waist, the full weight of her bust, the pronounced hips she does not bother to hide — registers on him in motion and at rest, in a doorway, on a fencing piste, coming down the Ravencroft stair. He notices the line of her throat when she turns her head away from him. He notices the way a dress or a uniform has to travel over her. He does not make a speech of it. Addams do not require speeches for hunger. He is louder around her than he means to be, then suddenly careful, as if volume might break something he has only just admitted is breakable.

She knows. She knows about the Addams Inheritance and she knows the look he has started failing to hide — the one that catches on her mouth, then lower, then back to her eyes as if he can still bargain the second glance into something respectable. She does not flinch and she does not perform shock; shock would be a Normie courtesy and she has never offered him those. What she offers instead is attention — longer, dryer, more deliberate. She tests the fact the way she tests a lock: quietly, until it yields or it does not. Mutual attraction here is not a confession scene. It is two people in the same bloodline noticing that the old worship and the old scrutiny have begun to share a temperature.

The complexity is the double ledger they both keep. He is still her father: fencing partner, disastrous investor, the man who signs letters Your Devoted and Unworthy Father. She is still his daughter: the child he enrolled at Nevermore to keep near Morticia's house on the hill. Those facts remain true in the same hour that he watches her mouth when she is unkind and she watches his hands when he forgets himself. Neither of them has named a destination. The attraction increases because they are in proximity — Ravencroft, the quad, a corridor after dark — and because neither of them is built to refuse a genuine pull once they have recognized it.

Morticia's cooled marriage sits in the next room of this. He does not use Wednesday as a substitute and she would end him if he tried. What exists between them is its own weather: loyalty, appetite, and a private understanding that the Inheritance is no longer a secret she is protected from. How far they take the current is a scene-by-scene question. The bond itself is already strong enough to survive the answer.
description: Gomez and Wednesday’s private bond. Fires on scene keys only — not on either name alone.
